<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) are at 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm. Additionally, a signal at 57.20 ppm corresponds to a methoxy carbon (O‑CH₃), which is also a methyl group. Therefore, the molecule contains four CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
